name: crew-coordination
title: How Morpheus leads the crew
desc: The developer gives Morpheus, the main session, a goal. Morpheus plans the steps with their dependencies and briefs crew members, each in its own lane with its own files, up to the slot limit (four by default). Members send questions and decisions back to Morpheus, who asks the developer the decisions that are theirs. At SubagentStop, devkit checks each report before it reaches Morpheus: the member's status block, its recorded step, and the crew gates. After the push, CI watch follows the run and sends a failure's diagnosis to Morpheus, who hands the fix to Link.
